Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Nb centers coordinated by six O neighbors, while La centers show 9-coordinate oxygen environments and Mg centers adopt 4-coordinate oxygen environments. The O centers display several geometric coordination sets, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-sharing between Nb octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites.
